key_facts.claim: Ninja Van Singapore is a logistics company operating in Singapore and other Southeast Asian markets.

evidence.quote: Singapore‑based logistics company Ninja Van has laid off about 12% of its local staff
Logistics company Ninja Van has cut about 12 per cent of its Singapore workforce

key_facts.claim: The company announced a restructuring that included laying off roughly 12% of its Singapore workforce in August 2025.

evidence.quote: Ninja Van lays off 12% of local workforce in latest restructuring exercise
Ninja Van retrenches 12% of workforce in S'pore

key_facts.claim: Layoffs were described as part of a long‑term plan to strengthen the business model and ensure sustainable growth.

evidence.quote: part of a long‑term plan to strengthen its business model and ensure sustainable growth
job cuts are part of the company’s long‑term effort to strengthen its business model

key_facts.claim: Affected employees were offered severance, extended health insurance, mental‑health support and career transition assistance.

evidence.quote: receive severance packages, extended health insurance and mental health support until 31 December
affected employees will receive a severance package, including those with less than two years of service

positive_signals.claim: Ninja Van continues to have open job listings for Singapore‑based roles, indicating ongoing operations.

evidence.quote: a check on Ninja Van’s job openings ... showed it still has positions open for more than 10 Singapore‑based roles

positive_signals.claim: The company has raised significant venture funding, including a US$578 million Series E round in 2021.

evidence.quote: raised US$578 million in a Series E round in 2021 from participants including Alibaba and B Capital Group

red_flags.claim: Multiple customer reviews describe poor service, unresponsive support channels, and delivery issues.

evidence.quote: live chat ... utterly useless and dismissive ... terrible service
All help lines - Viber, Messenger, Telegram - seem bogus. A live agent is never with you

red_flags.claim: Several complaints mention undelivered parcels, false delivery notifications, and lack of tracking information.

evidence.quote: Stated delivered at 11am today. But now is 8pm, and i have not receive my goods
No able to track parcel online, the website brings me round the circle

red_flags.claim: Recent layoffs affected a sizable portion of staff, which may indicate financial or operational stress.

evidence.quote: laid off about 12% of its local staff
Ninja Van has laid off about 12% of its Singapore workforce yesterday
